installCommand: pnpm_bin="$(command -v pnpm)" && pnpm_package="@pnpm/exe.linux-$(node -p process.arch)" && npm install --global "${pnpm_package}@12.1.0" && cp "$(npm root -g)/${pnpm_package}/pnpm" "$pnpm_bin" && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: tmp="$(mktemp -d)" && npx --yes pnpm@12.1.0 --filter ../../packages/eve pack --pack-destination "$tmp" && mkdir -p public && cp "$tmp"/eve-*.tgz public/eve.tgz && npx --yes pnpm@12.1.0 build
